notes.title: Update Alpha-0.2
notes.notes:
New features:

[list]
[*]Score Screen: Changed the scoring screen to a graph over time for more detail information of the players performance.
[*]Curser Effects: When the pyramid spills its curses, the players get visual cues.
[*]Players drop their inventory on death.
[*]Players can now Respawn on death, paying at maximum 50% of there loot depending on their current curse rank.
[*]Traps can now occure in the pyramid, having at maximum a 50% spring chance depending on their current curse rank.
[*]Treausres can now occure in the pyramid. Those are interactable and giving much loot at no curse cost.
[*]Masks can now occure in the pyramid. Those are items which can be activated via the alternative action button. If activated the mask is put on and gives the player visual augmentations at the cost of a certain curse points per second.
[/list]

Improvements:

[list]
[*]Completely reworked the networked inventory to be hopefully stable at last
[*]Added colliders to doors to keep them free of rubble, which could block them
[*]Doors which would spawn on the tip of a ladder, are now moved back a bit
[*]The rectile for timed interaction is bigger
[*]Updated the item icons.
[*]Showing current loot amount in the tab panel.
[*]Reworked the algorithm how paths between rooms are generated. Resulting in way shorter dungeon paths and eventually more connections (if configured via me)
[*]Implemented finally a "neck" resulting in not glitching into the character model. 
[*]Increased the range for the brightness setting.
[/list]

Bugfixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where props where not synced correctly
[*]Fixed an issue where the client has frame drops near an osiris statue
[*]Enemy hit sound now correctly networked
[/list]

Balancing Changes:

[list]
[*]Dimmed the lights
[/list]

notes.title: Update PreAlpha-0.1.40
notes.notes:
New features:

[list]
[*]Added new mechanic Cursed Treasures:
  Cursed Treasures are a special type of loot, that can be found inside the pyramid. They give a large amount of fame at the cost of a curse that is applied to the whole party.
  If someone dares to steal a Cursed Treasure, voting pillars are spawned in the starting room and at the end of each section. At this pillars players can vote by selecting a mask for a player which they believe has stolen the treasure. Players cam also remove a mask from the pillar, making it impossible to vote for that player on this pillar. The pillar can only be interacted with once per player.
  If the right player was voted for, the curse is lifted. Anyway the player which has been chosen is killed.	
[/list]
Improvements:

[list]
[*]Reworked the way occlusion works to have more control  over the lights in the pyramid.
[*]Added ambient sound in the playerhub
[/list]

notes.title: Vases, Toxic & Health
notes.notes:
New features:
-Added Vases: 
 Vases work like loot boxes and are spawned throughout the pyramid. Most likely in rooms. They can contain treasures as well as perils and items (future). There are three types of vases giving different probabilities to the outcome.

-Player Health:
 Players now have health and can actually die. There is currently fall damage and toxic damage. If no damage was taken in the last couple of seconds, the player auto heals to 25%. The healthbar can be seen in the Tab-Panel.

-Give up:
 If the player is hoplessly lost, they can give up over the Pause Menu.

-Toxic:
 Is a damage mechanic and can currently be found in vases. Toxic currently stacks up to 5 (1 stack per sec) dealing 2 DPS per stack. 1 stack per sec is removed, if standing outside of a toxic cloud.
 The players can actually die within a toxic cloud, but not outside. Outside leaves them alive with 1% heatlh remaining.

Bugfixes:
-Player Audio now correctly Spatialized
-Volumne Sliders now working
-Head drops now shadow
-Shifting player models, cause of rootmotion
-Running while crouch is toggled on, quits crouch now.
